errors.description: The manuscript reports 20 weeks of HFD exposure, but the methods describe 3 weeks before group assignment followed by 12 weeks of treatment. That schedule gives 12 weeks on the assigned diet, not 20; it appears to conflate the mice’s age at study end with HFD duration.
errors.evidence: Methods: mice were purchased at 5 weeks, randomly divided after 3 weeks, and euthanized after a 12-week treatment. Results: “Mice were fed by a 60% kcal fat diet for 20 weeks”; Figure 6 caption: kidneys were from groups “for 20 weeks.”

errors.location: Results—mouse biochemical measurements; Figure 5, panel H
errors.description: Serum creatinine is reported with conflicting units: μmol/L in the results and mmol/L in the Figure 5 panel H label. These units differ by a factor of 1,000, so the reported scale is ambiguous.
errors.evidence: Results: “serum creatinine (4.8 ± 1.3 vs. 1.11 μmol/L)”; Figure 5 panel H label: “Serum Creatinine (mmol/L).”
